title: EPC-RawDC: Equivariant Physics Constrained 3D Diffusion with Raw Data Consistency for CBCT to CT Image Synthesis
abstract: arXiv:2610.40046v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Cone beam computed tomography (CBCT) is widely used for image guided and adaptive radiotherapy, but scatter, noise, reconstruction artifacts, and inaccurate Hounsfield units limit its quantitative use. Recent diffusion approaches for CBCT to CT synthesis remain largely image driven, with limited use of the underlying acquisition physics. We propose EPC-RawDC, a conditional 3D latent diffusion framework that combines volumetric generative modeling with two complementary constraints derived from the same scanner specific CBCT forward model. First, geometry equivariant projection constraint exploits the rotational equivariance of the CBCT forward operator by supervising the synthesized CT through correspondingly transformed reference projections. Second, raw data consistency uses noisy projection measurements of the individual acquisition as scan specific supervision during training. The framework was evaluated on two independent clinical

translated_title: EPC-RawDC：结合等变物理约束与原始数据一致性的三维扩散模型用于CBCT到CT图像合成
translated_abstract: 锥形束计算机断层扫描（CBCT）广泛应用于图像引导和自适应放射治疗，但散射、噪声、重建伪影以及不准确的Hounsfield值限制了其定量应用。近期用于CBCT到CT合成的扩散方法大多仍以图像为驱动，对底层采集物理的利用十分有限。我们提出EPC-RawDC，这是一个条件三维潜在扩散框架，将体积生成建模与源自同一扫描仪特定CBCT正向模型的两个互补约束相结合。第一，几何等变投影约束利用CBCT正向算子的旋转等变性，通过相应变换后的参考投影对合成的CT进行监督。第二，原始数据一致性在训练期间利用单次采集的带噪投影测量数据作为扫描特定的监督信号。该框架在两个独立的临床数据集上进行了评估（原文摘要至此截断）。
tldr: 提出EPC-RawDC条件三维潜在扩散框架，通过几何等变投影约束和原始数据一致性两项约束将CBCT采集物理融入生成建模，从而实现更高质量的CBCT到CT图像合成。
en_tdlr: Proposes EPC-RawDC, a conditional 3D latent diffusion framework that embeds CBCT acquisition physics into generative modeling via geometry equivariant projection constraints and raw data consistency for improved CBCT-to-CT image synthesis.
